text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A year has passed since the last summer camp. It's time to get back to the grindstone so we can make even greater improvements.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The future is still up in the air, but Hishi Akebono seems to want to enjoy summer without worrying too much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our blistering summer camp gets underway with a promise to watch fireworks together!
